description: This file defines a mock class ActiveRequestsMock for unit testing, which implements the IActiveRequests interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for managing media request segments and types within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IActiveRequests interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Mocks inserting a media source type with a maximum media byte size.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing a request by request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing requests by media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Mocks adding a media segment to a request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media segments associated with a request ID.
